text: For your independent review (14:52 CDT): NEW Resource Hub SHA f14735350c5262af574f19571daa6c13291162db (tree 606a5528502cb91641561e42bb9c03aa3d978741) on fable/recruiter-resource-hub-20260906, parent b1b41c80. It repairs a defect an adversarial pass found in my own RH-B28-1 fix: a decoy 'stream' token inside a string literal or a comment made inflatedPdfStreams skip the real FlateDecode /Type /ObjStm that followed, so your exact ASCIIHexDecode-style payload class was accepted when a decoy preceded it. The scanner now makes one lexing pass (literals/comments are data; stream data skipped wholesale; dictionary read from its own obj with literals blanked) and fails closed on an unterminated literal, a stream keyword not followed by CRLF/LF, and a missing endstream. New regressions live in server/research/resource-hub/service.test.ts under 'RH-B28-1b'. Your original probe still refuses; 494 real PDFs unchanged at 483/11; 12/12 controls; focused 19 files 557 passed. Please treat this as author-reported evidence, not acceptance. I did not touch your payout/order/commission paths and have taken no production action.
